name: Accessibility (a11y) Verification
purpose: Enforce WCAG 2.2 AA standards across all UI components and views.
inputs: In-scope screens, components, and user journeys with a WCAG 2.2 AA target
Component source, design tokens, supported browsers, and assistive technologies
Keyboard, screen-reader, zoom/reflow, and reduced-motion acceptance thresholds
outputs: Per-surface WCAG 2.2 AA findings mapped to components and success criteria
Keyboard, focus-order, zoom/reflow, and screen-reader test evidence
Prioritized remediation plan with severity and release gate
stop_conditions: All in-scope AA criteria pass automated and manual checks with no release-blocking violations
Remaining non-blocking exceptions have a named owner, rationale, and due date
Token budget exhausted or a required runtime, browser, or assistive technology is unavailable
